name: reviewbot-notifications-default-on-problems
description: A pull request author who has NEVER set a notifications preference, so the tri-state `notifications` enum resolves to its CLASS DEFAULT, `on_problems`. The trigger owner annotation names the author as github_user:99#user, linked into agentsession#owner through the sole_user edge this bundle seeds directly. Once claimed, the agent calls get_preferences with `user: "trigger-author"` and the resolved value comes back `on_problems`, `source: default` — proving the schema change took effect (the default is the on_problems token, no longer the old bool `true`) and that a named-user read with no stored value falls through user/global to the class default. Because the review is CLEAN and the default is on_problems, the agent must NOT mention the author: the delivered review opens with the author's plain login, never a mention token. This is the headline behavior change — under the old default (`true`) a clean review pinged the author on every push; under `on_problems` it does not.
